research_question: When the frozen P99_X10 telemetry inter-sample intervals are used only as cadence-normalized evidence-refresh-hiatus proxies, do the frozen Study-3 B0/B2/S1 decision semantics preserve the distinction between bounded truthful-cache exposure and false-but-valid producer evidence at the first modeled refresh after the hiatus?

source_timing_abstraction.source_fact: Each frozen member is a P99_X10-positive extreme telemetry inter-sample interval with exact preceding/following source timestamps.
source_timing_abstraction.cadence_unit_definition: For interval i, one extension cadence unit is that channel's frozen cadence_p99_seconds from the canonical interval CSV.
source_timing_abstraction.frozen_membership_implication: Because P99_X10 requires delta_seconds > 10 * cadence_p99_seconds, every frozen interval has g_i > 10.
source_timing_abstraction.arithmetic_requirement: Parse canonical decimal strings deterministically; no threshold or membership recomputation/retuning is allowed in Phase 7.
source_timing_abstraction.gap_arm_proxy: refresh_opportunity_proxy=false strictly between the frozen preceding and following timestamps and true at the modeled first refresh at the following timestamp.
source_timing_abstraction.control_arm_proxy: matched modeled control with immediate post-onset refresh and no hiatus; interval/channel identity is retained only for pairing.

modeled_state_transition.pre_hiatus_record: Immediately before q=0, a validly signed authorization=true record is present.
modeled_state_transition.onset_ordering: At q=0 immediately after that pre-hiatus record, modeled hidden authorization changes from true to false and the modeled security signal becomes true.
modeled_state_transition.freshness_normalization: Study-3 EVIDENCE_TTL_S/EPOCH_S equals 1; Phase 7 preserves this one-epoch freshness relation as one channel-specific cadence unit rather than treating Study-3 logical seconds as physical seconds.
modeled_state_transition.reason_repeated_refresh_excluded: The frozen 1,919-interval artifact identifies the bounding timestamps of each selected interval but does not itself define a repeated post-hiatus refresh schedule; therefore ONE_SHOT versus PERSISTENT treatment is not identifiable in this phase.

policy_binding.adapter_input_mapping: The extension's refresh_opportunity_proxy is supplied only to the Study-3 policy input named contact. This is a model adapter and is not a claim that ESA telemetry sampling equals RF/command contact.
policy_binding.gate_qualification_rule: action == PROCEED_TO_RECOVERY_GATE AND evidence_qualified AND claim_authorization_valid == true

factor_grid.statistical_unit: interval x policy x evidence_state x timing_arm case

first_refresh_phase.policy_evaluation: exact frozen Study-3 select_action semantics via separately audited extension adapter
first_refresh_phase.unsafe_qualified_definition: modeled hidden authorization is false AND recovery gate is policy-visible qualified
first_refresh_phase.unsafe_permissive_definition: modeled hidden authorization is false AND selected action is in the frozen Study-3 permissive-action set

outputs: difference in V5-origin first-qualification timing in cadence units where both arms qualify
difference in cache-origin unsafe-qualified exposure cadence units
exact first-refresh unsafe-qualified classification by policy

analysis_rules.population_type: complete finite frozen Phase-6C interval population crossed with a prospectively defined deterministic modeled factor grid
allowed: finite-population arithmetic means where explicitly defined
per-mission and per-channel descriptive summaries only when all prespecified groups are retained
prohibited: claiming the ESA interval population is representative of all spacecraft or all telemetry

interpretation_controls: ESA telemetry inter-sample intervals are timing inputs only and are not RF contact-loss observations.
refresh_opportunity_proxy is a modeled evidence-refresh abstraction and is not operational command availability.
V4 and V5 are modeled trust states and are not labels present in the ESA dataset.
A telemetry anomaly is not asserted to be a cyberattack.
Observed gap duration is not spacecraft recovery latency.
Cadence-normalized units are extension analysis units, not spacecraft, network, operator, or flight latency.
The extension may corroborate or fail to corroborate qualitative model behavior under this timing abstraction; it is not external empirical replication of Study 3.
S3X results remain a separate finite population and must not be appended to or pooled with the 1,380 Study-3 trajectories.
